item.title: Sony's Bringing Back Spider-Man $2.5 Billion Hit With New Footage
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: Spider-Man casting/sequel gossip and rerelease hype.] Spider-Man: Brand New Day isn't done dominating movie theaters, with Sony planning an extended rerelease of 2026's Spider-Man cinematic feat.
item.content:encoded: As Marvel Studios' release of Avengers Endgame: Encore proves, blockbuster movies can still dominate the box office, even after a multibillion dollar run. Sony is reportedly planning a rerelease of Spider-Man: Brand New Day to bring web-head-heads back to movie theaters — and like Endgame: Encore, the studio is adding new footage of Spider-Man's latest flick as an incentive.

item.title: Top 10 Pokémon Cards Most Likely to Be Fake
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/counterfeit story, not video game related.] Counterfeit Pokémon cards is a big business, but some TCG cards are more suspicious than others. Here's how to tell fakes from legit Pokémon cards.
item.content:encoded: The more Pokémon trading cards pop off, the more potential players and collectors have to worry about one thing: counterfeit cards. Sometimes, a fake card will be obvious. As more money pours into the hobby, however, there's more incentive than ever to pull a fast one on people. Fakes are getting harder to tell from authentic ones, but it helps to know what Pokémon cards are the most likely targets — and what you should look out for in general while inspecting singles.

item.title: Calvin and Hobbes' Final Strip is Still the Perfect Goodbye
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about classic comic strip from decades ago.] Back in 1995, catoonist Bill Watterson brought Calvin and Hobbes to a perfect conclusion
item.content:encoded: On November 18, 1985, the very first comic strip of Calvin and Hobbes appeared in newspapers. “So long, pop! I’m off to check my tiger trap!” Calvin, wearing a safari helmet, said to his dad in the first panel. Calvin went on to explain that he rigged the trap with a tuna fish sandwich, something a tiger cannot resist. In the last panel, Hobbes is seen for the first time, hanging upside down in a tree, eating the sandwich.

item.title: 10 Essential NES Games Still Missing From Switch Online
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: [Filtered: Generic retrospective/list about old games, not news.] Nintendo Switch Online may offer dozens of great titles, but 10 must-have NES games still haven't reached the service.
item.content:encoded: The Nintendo Entertainment System is credited with rescuing a flailing industry back in the late ‘80s and early ‘90s. Over the years, hundreds of amazing games launched for the console, and many of the best and most memorable of them are now available to play on Nintendo Switch Online. However, dozens of other fantastic titles still haven’t reached the service, and that needs to change. Out of those dozens remaining, here are 10 NES games that still need to come to Switch Online as soon as possible.

item.title: Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season start time
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's what time Fortnite maintenance for the Chapter 7 mini season starts and ends, in your time zone.
item.content:encoded: The Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, "Treasure Hunters," is upon us, with Chapter 7 Season 4 coming to a close on Nov. 1. Video games are so out. The new "in" thing? Pirates. Pirates are so in. As usual, Season 4 will end and the game will have a lengthy maintenance period. After maintenance is over, you'll be able to jump into the mini season as soon as you log in.

item.title: The 10 Best Star Trek: The Next Generation Episodes, Ranked
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective ranking old TV episodes, not substantial.] From Tapestry to The Inner Light, these are the 10 best Star Trek: The Next Generation episodes, ranked.
item.content:encoded: One of the great things about Star Trek: The Next Generation is that you never quite knew what kind of adventure you were going to get. One week, the Enterprise might be facing an enemy capable of destroying the Federation. The next, Captain Picard could be living an entire lifetime on an alien planet. And occasionally, Worf would find himself dressed as one of Robin Hood's Merry Men, looking like he'd rather be anywhere else in the galaxy.

item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Prime Video, Prime Video, Paramount, and Peacock (October 30 - November 1)
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Generic streaming clickbait without specific prestige/anticipated projects.] On this weekend's streaming and VOD movie column, there's a post-apocalyptic blockbuster, an erotic thriller, and much more.
item.content:encoded: It’s Halloween weekend! To celebrate, movie theaters across the country are hosting Scream’s 30th anniversary screenings and V for Vendetta, which is celebrating its 20th anniversary. If you’re planning on staying home, check out our Halloween Countdown, filled with spooky recommendations.

item.title: All Esper locations in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find each Esper location in Final Fantasy Resonance and how to recruit them
item.content:encoded: Final Fantasy Resonance's Espers give Fina an extra edge in combat, or sometimes they're just convenient decoys to bait the enemy into attacking them and not your party. However you use them, Espers are definitely worth the MP it costs to summon them. You have to put in some extra work to obtain them, though. Espers are tucked away in different spots around Resonance's world, and you have to find and often fight them before Fina can use their powers.

item.title: Before 'Crystal Lake', Bryan Fuller Created an Overlooked Fantasy Series You Can Watch for Free
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait promoting free content, not substantive TV news.] Before Crystal Lake and Hannibal, Bryan Fuller created Dead Like Me, a dark fantasy comedy about grim reapers. Both seasons stream free on Tubi.
item.content:encoded: Bryan Fuller is a master of mixing horror, fantasy, and black comedy. Before Crystal Lake, the Friday the 13th prequel whose premiere shares a story credit between Fuller and showrunner Brad Caleb Kane, Fuller became best known for bringing another iconic killer to television in Hannibal. But his fascination with death has also produced stories that are more quirky than terrifying.

item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV streaming recommendations without prestige/anticipated projects.] On this week's TV column, there's a new Apple TV thriller, the return of an HBO hit, a documentary series, and more.
item.content:encoded: Happy weekend! As we prepare for the influx of TV shows to come in November, including major releases likeThe Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, there are a few noteworthy entries this week to keep you occupied while you wait.

A Court of Thorns and Roses
item.description: [Filtered: Book recommendations outside Polygon's gaming/horror focus.] From the new Sarah Maas to Jane Schoenbrun’s debut novel, this week has something for everyone
item.content:encoded: As we move through an era where cinema is popping off, giving us great films that everyone is talking about like You Can See Everythingand The Devils, it can't be forgotten that this week is also a great one for new book releases from the past year. A new Sarah J. Maas book, a horror occult book by a Nebula-winning author, and the first novel from Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasmadirector Jane Schoenbrun. We would say it's a good week to pick up a book, but honestly, it's always a good time to read.

item.title: How to open the Crimson Manor in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Learn how to open the Crimson Manor in Phantom Blade Zero in this guide and what you find inside the mysterious place.
item.content:encoded: The Crimson Manor is a mysterious location in Phantom Blade Zero that you discover after riding a suspicious elevator in the Weeping Creek Valley. Although you can visit it in the first few hours of the game, the doors to the somber building won't budge until you have a unique key that fits the puppet-shaped lock. Unlocking the manor is a secondary mission, but one that helps you learn more about a central character and achieve the game's true ending.

item.title: 2026’s Secret 'Robin Hood' Movie Suddenly Drops on Streaming After Bombing in Theaters
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait: movie bombing, dropping on streaming service.] 'The Uprising' is headed for Peacock on Nov. 6, less than two months after hitting theaters.
item.content:encoded: Another 2026 box office flop is heading to streaming after a short theatrical run. The Uprising, which was briefly marketed in the U.S. as The Uprising: The Rise of Robin Hood, will stream exclusively on Peacock in early November.

item.title: HBO’s New Green Lantern Series Officially Gets an Important Update
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: DC series update; generic animated series news falls under toss.] HBO's My Adventures with Green Lantern reveals official episode count and Superman season 4 update.
item.content:encoded: DC and HBO first announced My Adventures with Green Lanternback in 2025, and updates since then have been sparse. It was briefly shown off during this year's Annecy International Animation Festival, but nothing at the convention was released publicly. Now, DC Studios co-lead Peter Safran has finally given a small but much-needed update on the project.

item.title: OpenAI Billionaire: PCs Are 'Terrible' When Data Centers Need More Memory
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: AI/tech news unrelated to gaming or adjacent hobbies.] OpenAI's Sam Altman argues against hoarding computer chips versus giving it all to ChatGPT's data centers
item.content:encoded: Here's a fun fact: from now until 2029, OpenAI owns 40% of the world's supply of Dynamic Random Access Memory (DRAM), which powers cell phones, video game consoles, and artificial intelligence. The ChatGPT maker is thus one of the key reasons you have to pay $650 for a PS5 now, and why no one can affordably build a new gaming PC. Somehow, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman thinks that percentage isn't enough.

item.title: 'Star Wars Fate of the Galaxy' Officially Released for Free
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: [Filtered: Star Wars fan game; big-franchise churn topic.] The Star Wars space combat fan game 'Fate of the Galaxy' has finally been released after almost two decades of development.
item.content:encoded: Never doubt the tenacity of Star Wars fans. After close to 20 years of development, a group of volunteers is finally releasing Fate of the Galaxy, a Star Wars space combat game built on FreeSpace 2’s open-source engine. This total conversion mod was developed using FreeSpace Open and is available for free on Linux, Mac, and PC.

item.title: Where to use the coin mining den key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Our guide shows the exact location to use the coin mining den key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4.
item.content:encoded: The coin mining den key in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is one of many keys you can find in the extraction mode, used to unlock a locked door somewhere in the map that contains lots of loot behind it. Obtained by completing the "Operation Shopping Hacks" mission, the coin mining den key is described as opening the "e-coin mining lab in NuriGO West, east of the westernmost gas station inside NuriGO Mall."

item.title: James Gunn Officially Comments on Casting the DCU's New Batman
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: DC casting gossip; big-franchise churn, not substantial news.] DC's new Batman hasn't been cast yet, but James Gunn says it 'won't be too long'
item.content:encoded: It has been clear for a while now that Robert Pattinson won't be the DC Universe's Batman, even with The Batman Part II still slated for release in 2028. Fans will be sad to see BatPat go, especially considering DC Studios co-head James Gunn has kept quiet on when we will see his successor. Thankfully, Gunn has finally given a small but meaningful update on the casting process for the next Bruce Wayne.

item.title: Best Visions to use in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The best Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance combine excellent skills with universally useful mastery abilities
item.content:encoded: There's so many to choose from that deciding on the best Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance often feels more than a little overwhelming. While every Vision has something that makes them worth using in certain circumstances, there is a set of them that excels in practically every situation. And you can find most of them early in the game, too.

item.title: Marvel, Star Trek Stars Post Heartbreaking Tributes to Patrick Stewart
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: [Filtered: Celebrity death tribute; lacks gaming/horror/film substance.] Patrick Stewart died at the age of 86 on Wednesday, and fellow actors from X-Men, Star Trek, and Dune are paying their respects in heartfelt tributes.
item.content:encoded: Patrick Stewart's friends, colleagues, and fellow actors are paying tribute to the late thespian, who died on Wednesday at the age of 86. In the wake of Stewart's death, heartfelt tributes have poured in across social media, including a heartbreaking remembrance from the actor's longtime collaborator, friend, and fellow knight Ian McKellen.

item.title: My Chemical Romance and Lauren Tsai Team Up for Short Movie Featuring Hideo Kojima
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino

item.description: [Filtered: Music news with film cameo; not game/horror/prestige film focused.] Lauren Tsai has made a short film for New Jersey band My Chemical Romance, featuring Billie Eilish, Phoebe Bridgers, and Kojima.

Drawing on The Dying World and its characters, she created a short film based on "The End," the first song on My Chemical Romance's 2006 album The Black Parade.

item.title: 10 Queer Fairy Tale Retellings Better Than the Originals
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: [Filtered: Generic book list; not games, horror, or prestige content.] What makes a great queer fairy-tale retelling? Explore our top 10 picks for the best creative spins on classic tales.
item.content:encoded: As a queer woman growing up, it was pretty easy to neg on all things fairy-tale. Perhaps I had reason to, as mockery of all things Disney has grown popular in recent years.

item.title: 34 Years Later, Hobbes' Wisest 'Calvin and Hobbes' Line Is Still a Perfect Comic Strip Quote
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective; generic "years later" piece.] And if I laugh at any mortal thing, 'tis that I may not weep
item.content:encoded: Here's something that might win you some points in a trivia game someday: Bill Watterson named the protagonists of Calvin and Hobbes after two European philosophers. John Calvin (1509-1564) was a controversial theologian whose ideas gave rise to the predestination-oriented Calvinist branch of Protestantism (thus mucking everything up for everyone for centuries to come). Thomas Hobbes (1588-1679) wrote Leviathan, one of the foundational works of social contract theory.

item.title: 10 Essential Fantasy Books You Need to Read at Least Once in Your Life
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: [Filtered: Graphic novel/book promo retrospective, not game-related content] From Tolkien's Middle-earth to Lovecraft's dreamscapes, these 10 essential fantasy books deserve a place on your shelf.
item.content:encoded: Fantasy has always offered a way to step beyond the boundaries of reality, inviting readers into worlds where the impossible becomes part of everyday life. The genre stretches back to ancient folklore, epic poetry, and fairy tales, existing long before the modern fantasy novel took shape, in which sorcery and magical worlds abound. From the mythological journeys of Homer to the dreamlike stories of George MacDonald, imaginative literature has continually found new ways to explore humanity through the extraordinary.

item.title: Steam Makes 96% Positive Puzzle Game Completely Free
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming filler: free game availability announcement] Hexologic is free to keep on Steam for a limited time. Claim this relaxing Sudoku-inspired puzzle game and solve more than 90 levels.
item.content:encoded: Puzzle games have a special way of making you feel clever. Whether you’re solving elaborate environmental challenges in Portal 2, untangling mind-bending mysteries in The Witness, or figuring out the next move in Baba Is You, few things are as satisfying as finally cracking a puzzle that’s had you stumped.

item.title: Patrick Stewart's Greatest Captain Picard Quote Is Still a Defining Star Trek Moment
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV nostalgia retrospective without real substance] "The Inner Light" contains Jean-Luc Picard's greatest quote, a quiet line that reveals the humanity behind Star Trek's most beloved captain.
item.content:encoded: Every Star Trek fan has an opinion on the franchise's greatest captain. Some prefer the swagger of James T. Kirk (William Shatner). Others admire Benjamin Sisko (Avery Brooks) for his conviction, or Kathryn Janeway (Kate Mulgrew) for her resilience. But ultimately, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) usually wins those debates because he embodied the very best of Starfleet: intelligence, diplomacy, curiosity, and compassion.

item.title: Star Trek and X-Men Icon Patrick Stewart Dies at 86
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: [Filtered: Celebrity news unrelated to games, film, TV, or horror] Sir Patrick Stewart, the actor famous for roles in Star Trek: The Next Generation, X-Men films, and Dune, has died, his family announced.
item.content:encoded: Patrick Stewart, the actor best known for his commanding roles as Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film franchise, has died, according to a statement from his family. Stewart was 86.

item.title: 'Whence the Weeping' quest walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how you complete the "Whence the Weeping" side quest in Phantom Blade Zero and where you must go to find the source of the weeping.
item.content:encoded: "Whence the Weeping" is a side quest in Phantom Blade Zero that you start very early in the game. Unlike the "A Healer's Mercy" and "Flesh Lily" secondary missions, which have more straightforward objectives, this quest asks you to simply "find the source of the weeping." Besides, it takes longer to finish than one would assume based on when this side quest starts.

item.title: New James Bond Officially Joins The 007 Franchise Today
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn casting news without substantial prestige project indicators.] Isaac Rouse is the new James Bond in SilverFin, an adaptation of 007 author Charlie Higson's young adult novel based on Ian Fleming's super spy.
item.content:encoded: Ian Fleming's James Bond is set for a cinematic revival with director Denis Villeneuve's in-the-works feature film, currently known colloquially as Bond 26. Casting for the new 007 is currently underway, with a half-dozen leading men in contention to succeed actor Daniel Craig, who retired as Bond in 2021's No Time To Die after starring in five franchise films.

item.title: How to get comms modules in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide explains how to get comms modules in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4 and the best locations to find them.
item.content:encoded: Getting comms modules in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a pain in the butt, because this epic-tier crafting ingredient is incredibly elusive if you don't know where to look. You need comms modules to unlock uncommon ingredient printing (along with high-tenacity fibers), to increase your weapon storage, and for other equipment such as fulton drop markers. Once you've unlocked epic ingredient printing you can simply make more, but that's not feasible until you've acquired even rarer ingredients.

item.title: 'Rings of Power' Season 3 Will Introduce a Character That Subverts Tolkien’s Mythos
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV series update without substantial film/prestige value.] 'The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power' will introduce an "Orc with an arc."
item.content:encoded: The Age of Men is over. The Age of the Orc Discourse has begun. In a recent interview with IGN about the upcoming season of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, co-showrunner Patrick McKay said big changes are coming, including a five-year time skip. McKay went as far as to describe season 3 as a “soft reboot” of sorts. While that’s certainly a big deal, another line in the interview will stand out for many Tolkien-heads. The show will introduce “an Orc with an arc.”

item.title: James Gunn Finally Confirming What’s Official DCU Canon in The Suicide Squad
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn (DC) with secondary podcast/canon clarification filler.] James Gunn will decide DCU canon in a podcast all about 2021's The Suicide Squad
item.content:encoded: Ever since James Gunn was named co-head of DC Studios in 2022, the filmmaker has spent years answering fan questions about what past and current projects constitute the new DC Universe canon. One of the biggest points of contention is 2021's The Suicide Squad, which Gunn directed before the new DCU was a thing. Now he's finally going to give the definitive answer on exactly what from the film is canon, and you'll be able to watch the whole thing.

item.title: Best Guns in the Modern Warfare 4 Beta
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Our guide lists the top five guns in the Modern Warfare 4 meta right now.
item.content:encoded: The best guns in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4are exactly what you should be using if you want to be part of the meta right now. This is one of the best Call of Duty multiplayer experiences in a long time, and with a vast array of guns to choose from, you can dominate the skill-based matchmaking and improve your kill-death ratio.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Avatar’s Deepest Episode Has Never Been More Important
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about 20-year-old episode, not new sequel news.] Avatar: The Last Airbender’s “The Guru” explains the chakras — and may hold the key to Pavi’s mysterious vision in Seven Havens episode 9.
item.content:encoded: “The Guru” is the penultimate episode of Avatar: The Last Airbender Book 2, and it introduces Guru Pathik (Brian George) as Aang’s (Zachary Tyler Eisen) spiritual guide. After receiving an invitation via Appa, Aang visits the Eastern Air Temple hoping to learn how he can master the Avatar state. Instead, he gets an elaborate lesson on the nature of spiritual energy and its relationship to the chakras. Nearly two decades after its original release, “The Guru” feels even more relevant than ever before.

item.title: 15 Years Later, the Most Near-Perfect Fast and Furious Movie Is Getting From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming-leaving clickbait; nostalgia retrospective framing ("15 years later").] Even after 11 movies, Fast Five is still the best by a mile. Watch it now, while you still can.
item.content:encoded: For a long time, I assumed the Fast & Furious franchise were beneath me. The movies appeared to be nothing more than a series of vapid car commercials and, not being much of a car guy, I wasn't interested. But during the pandemic, I got pressured into watching the first one and really enjoyed it. Before I knew it, I’d watched every installment and couldn’t wait for the next one. That's the power of family.

item.title: 9 Years Ago, Netflix Released a Rare Sci-Fi Sequel Even Better Than the Original
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective; generic TV series renewal/season news.] Season 2 of Stranger Things premiered nine years ago, which proved to be nearly as good as season 1 thanks to some great new characters
item.content:encoded: The “sophomore slump” or the “difficult second album” has generally been an expression that’s applied to music. After a band or a solo artist launches their career with a hit record, it can be challenging to recapture that same energy and excitement. After all, it's one thing to work on your best idea in solitude for years. It's another to suddenly feel immense pressure to follow-up that first hit with something even better. The same can hold true for TV. Many of the greatest television shows fail to deliver on their second outing — like Heroes and True Detective, to name just a couple.

item.title: 'Slow Horses' Season 7 Confirmed? Release Date, Plot, and Everything You Need to Know
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV series renewal news; non-horror, non-prestige series.] Here’s when you’ll find out what happens next after that brutal cliffhanger
item.content:encoded: Apple’s tight spy thriller Slow Horsesusually ties up each season-long mystery in six episodes, but the season 6 finale ended with a shocking cliffhanger. If you haven’t read Mick Herron’s Slough House books and are desperate to know what happens next, including which characters will be returning, we’ve got some answers. Here’s everything we know about Slow Horses season 7, including the potential release date and plot details.

item.title: All ribbon locations in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] In this guide, you find all ribbon locations in Phantom Blade Zero, and how to get there, so you can complete the "Young Mistress" side quest.
item.content:encoded: If you find all the ribbons in the Village of Lu you will complete an important Phantom Blade Zero side quest: "Young Mistress." They were left by Mu Xiaokui, daughter of Soul's master. He has known her since she was a child, and they have established a bond that you can only truly understand by hearing the short dialogues that play whenever you collect a ribbon. In addition, completing this side quest also makes the final boss fight in the area more challenging.

item.title: Where to find the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] In this guide, we explain where you can find the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero to complete Yu'er's side quest.
item.content:encoded: Locating the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero is part of one of the first secondary missions in the game. The "Flesh Lily" is a long quest that you only complete after reaching the fourth area in the game, Pangzhen. Although it takes a while for you to see the conclusion of this tale, completing the first step is worthwhile, as it involves obtaining one of the strongest weapons in the early game.

item.title: Where to find the Outpost cell key in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the cell key in Phantom Blade Zero to open the locked door in the Outpost Courtyard, and the reward from opening it.
item.content:encoded: The Outpost cell key is a secondary objective in Phantom Blade Zero that teaches you that exploring the maps thoroughly is worthwhile. As you progress in the story, you will come across plenty of locked doors, and it might take some time before you can obtain the means to open them, as some are connected to the main story.

item.title: 'A Healer's Mercy' quest walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Marloes Valentina Stella
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the wounded thieves' locations needed to complete 'A Healer's Mercy' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.content:encoded: To complete "A Healer's Mercy" in Phantom Blade Zero, you must find four lost thieves in the Crimson Forest, the second region. As none of them are waiting on the main path, it's quite a hassle to distribute Yu'er's medicine and get the thieves back to thieving.

item.title: All medicine locations for 'Apprentice Healer' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Marloes Valentina Stella
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the medicinal herb locations needed to complete the "Apprentice Healer" quest in Phantom Blade Zero
item.content:encoded: To complete the "Apprentice Healer" quest in Phantom Blade Zero, you must find three medicinal herbs for Yu'er. It's easier said than done, as two of these herbs are found in a hidden valley, and entering this mysterious location is quite the challenge on its own.

item.title: Where to find the primal stone for 'A Severed Mindseal' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Marloes Valentina Stella
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's the primal stone location needed to complete 'A Severed Mindseal' in Phantom Blade Zero.
item.content:encoded: To find the Primal Stone during the "A Severed Mindseal" quest in Phantom Blade Zero, you must search a mysterious tower imbued with primal energy. It's easier said than done, but you'll make the Friendly Shadow Warden (that odd fellow you met on the roof of the Sha-Chi Tower) very happy.

item.title: Scarlett Johansson’s Most Unsettling Sci-Fi Movie Is Officially Getting Cut From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming departure clickbait; not substantial prestige film coverage.] Scarlett Johansson’s strangest sci-fi movie is a haunting experience worth catching before it leaves Netflix.
item.content:encoded: Scarlett Johansson has spent years playing some of sci-fi’s most recognizable women. Luc Besson transformed her into something approaching a god in 2014’s Lucy, and the much-maligned live-action Ghost in the Shell gave her a fully cybernetically enhanced body to play around with in a near-future Newport City. Of course, there’s also Black Widow, the former assassin who became one of the Marvel Cinematic Universe’s most dependable heroes across nine films, from Iron Man 2 to Black Widow. Johansson has built a career playing characters who straddle the line between human and something otherworldly, but you’ve never seen ScarJo quite like this.

item.title: The best Han 86 build in Modern Warfare 4
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] A guide detailing the best Han 86 build in Modern Warfare 4, along with the loadout and class to run with it.
item.content:encoded: The best Han 86 build in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is likely to be something most players search for at one point or another, because it's the very first assault rifle you unlock in multiplayer. Not only that, but since the gun can be found on practically every single basic soldier in DMZ, it's incredibly easy to level it up and acquire most of the attachments.

item.title: How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in Final Fantasy 14, and how to participate in the Keybound Brawler event, the Final Fantasy 7 event.
item.content:encoded: Tifa and Barret's outfits are the real stars in Final Fantasy 14's event in the Keybound Brawlers, a new collaboration with Final Fantasy 7. Unlike Cloud's outfit, which is based on the Final Fantasy 7: Advent Children design and has been in the game for ages, these two are based on the FF7 remake project. To get them and many other FF7-themed cosmetics and items, you must survive the typing brawls and earn a special currency.

item.title: Discord's Massive New Change Will Shake Up The Entire Internet
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Non-gaming industry news, not Polygon gaming focus] A shift in Discord's discoverability has massive implications for Google and Reddit and possibly ChatGPT and Claude
item.content:encoded: The best and worst thing about Discord is that messages sent on its chat servers are ephemeral. On the one hand, it's nice to know that things said in a casual setting won't necessarily be plastered on the internet forever. On the other hand, Discord's temporality is frustrating when you need to find a critical piece of information. These defining characteristics for Discord are about to change — and the repercussions will be visible throughout the entire internet.
